schema.id: stable row id; also the note filename
schema.doc: the section the row was transcribed from
schema.block: construct name; selects the caret target through the runner's selector map
schema.target: optional: a construct name that overrides block for the caret target only
schema.index: optional: which match of the selector, default 0, negative counts from the end
schema.before: exact note bytes written to disk
schema.position: S | T | M | E | B | EMPTY (§3)
schema.operation: a key name, 'Type:<text>', or a comma chain of steps
schema.after: exact note bytes expected after save and exit; null = the docs pin no bytes (BLOCKED)
schema.note: why the row exists / what the owner would notice
schema.status: absent or 'assert' = scored; 'spec-divergent' = the doc marks it open or self-conflicting; 'engine' = native-engine dependent; 'blocked' = the docs do not pin the expected bytes (scored by nobody, observed by the runner)
schema.allowHtml: optional: the note already contains authored HTML (Q10/Q21), so only the tag multiset may not grow

operationGrammar.key: Playwright page.keyboard.press(key): Backspace, Delete, Enter, Shift+Enter, Tab, Shift+Tab, ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, ArrowUp, ArrowDown, End, Home, Ctrl+Z, Ctrl+B
operationGrammar.type: Type:<text> types the text character by character through the real engine, so live input rules fire as they do for a user
operationGrammar.chain: steps are comma-separated and run in order
operationGrammar.SelectBlock: selects the target block's contents (the doc's D operation)
operationGrammar.NoOp: dispatch nothing; save only (the doc's 'no edit' rows)

positionRule.S: before the block's first character (a container position at offset 0)
positionRule.T: offset 0 of the block's first text node, i.e. after the rendered marker
positionRule.M: between the block's middle characters: floor(textContent.length / 2), walking text nodes
positionRule.E: after the last character of the block
positionRule.B: the empty position after the target block, directly in the editor root
positionRule.EMPTY: the start of an empty block (a root caret when the note is empty)

invariants.html: no <tag> outside a fenced code block may appear in the saved file (I4/G4); a row with allowHtml must not gain a tag
invariants.chrome: the file never contains data-hybrid-, contenteditable, or hljs
invariants.sentinels: the file never contains NUL, the zero-width placeholder, a BOM, or a signature sentinel
invariants.noop: a row whose before equals after issues zero POST /api/file (I3)
invariants.pageerrors: no uncaught page error during the row
invariants.noTiming: R4: no row asserts a wait, an interval, or a save latency; every row saves explicitly

selectors.nested-list: #viewer-content > ul > li > ul > li (and the ol form)
